hero.subheadline: I turn messy systems into shippable products, useful automations, and calmer teams.

features.title: Features
features.intro: Longer pieces that keep the source trail attached. The first one is a reconstruction of Project Panama: what Anthropic destroyed, what it paid for, and which digitization paths it did not take.

items.title: Intact copies were an option
items.dek: Court records in Bartz v. Anthropic show how Claude’s maker built a private book library — pirate caches first, then millions of purchased print books discarded after scanning. Other programs had already solved this without the shredder. The $1.5 billion settlement did not buy the paper back.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Older site content points to a long technical program path across streaming media, e-commerce, mobile, and internal tools. Current public GitHub profile lists Zibby AI as the active company.

items.summary: Building AI agent and workflow systems from Austin, TX.
Led native app and PMO coordination across platform communications, readiness, reporting, releases, escalations, and agile delivery.
Led multidisciplinary Agile teams, stabilized Android delivery velocity, managed risks, documentation, and program-level communications.
Managed flagship streaming media products and platform work for clients including CBS, Univision, PIX System, NEP, and RED Hydrogen One.
Oversaw custom app delivery, trained customers on CMS workflows, designed UI/UX, built automation scripts, and deployed an internal Rails PM system.
Resolved customer device issues, supported business relationships, and presented educational workshops.

about.title: About
about.headline: I like big ideas. I love executing them.
about.body: My career has lived in the practical middle: product ambition, engineering reality, customer pressure, and the tools teams use to coordinate it all. Lately that work has centered on AI agents — not as magic, but as new teammates that need context, guardrails, and useful interfaces.
about.manifesto: The best systems make people calmer and more capable. I care about software that clarifies work, removes pointless ceremony, and leaves a trace you can inspect when something goes sideways.
about.education: BA, Management of Musical Enterprise — Baruch College
